exposure: Previous open abdominal surgery for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)
Previous laparoscopic abdominal surgery for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)
cohort: The study included 12,894 pregnancies among women with Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC) who gave birth in Denmark between 1997 and 2024.
finding: Prior abdominal surgery for inflammatory bowel disease is associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy and birth outcomes, and laparoscopic surgery does not reduce these risks compared to open surgery.
mod_finding: Prior surgery for IBD was associated with an increased risk of elective cesarean section in CD pregnancies, and with preterm elective, emergency, and elective cesarean sections in UC pregnancies.
